title: stellina
intro: Stellina, commonly known as Starwort, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Campanulaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to provide relief from various health issues due to its impressive array of health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Stellina include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems, making it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Stellina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a promising candidate for further research and development.
